name: Bytepaper
description_en:
Bytepaper is currently presented as a WhatsApp-centered customer engagement and sales application. A shared inbox, lead pipeline, chatbot qualification and follow-up workflows surround the conversation, so work can move from an inquiry to an assigned lead or order. The current homepage is narrower and more concrete than a generic CRM feature list.

The practical question is whether your acquisition channels, company WhatsApp setup and team handoffs match the documented configuration. Bytepaper also advertises marketing broadcasts, structured WhatsApp Flows and optional integrations; their plan and provider dependencies need checking. This profile separates these paths and identifies inconsistent price tables and legacy text instead of treating every page fragment as a single current offer. No account, campaign, payment, bot or connector was executed.
description_zh:
Bytepaper 当前主要定位为围绕 WhatsApp 的客户互动和销售应用。共享收件箱、线索管线、机器人资格判断及后续工作流围绕沟通展开，让咨询推进到分配后的线索或订单。当前首页比通用 CRM 功能表更聚焦具体用途。

选型关键是获客渠道、公司 WhatsApp 配置及团队交接是否符合文档模型。Bytepaper 还宣传营销群发、结构化 WhatsApp Flows 及可选集成，需要核对套餐和服务商依赖。本文区分这些路径，指出价格表不一致及旧文字，不把每段网页内容合成一份当前报价；未执行账户、活动、支付、机器人或连接器。

core_features.explanation_en: Assign and collaborate on conversations with lead context and team ownership.
core_features.explanation_zh: 结合线索背景及团队负责人分配、协作处理沟通。

core_features.explanation_en: Collect customer requirements through a bot and route the resulting conversation to an agent.
core_features.explanation_zh: 通过机器人采集客户需求，再把沟通交给坐席。

core_features.explanation_en: Collect inputs with forms and choices inside WhatsApp when the selected plan/setup supports them.
core_features.explanation_zh: 所选套餐／配置支持时，在 WhatsApp 中用表单和选项收集输入。

core_features.explanation_en: Map lead form variables into follow-up templates and route leads with configured rules.
core_features.explanation_zh: 把线索表单变量带入跟进模板，并按配置规则分配线索。

en: Qualify an incoming product inquiry and assign it to a salesperson.
Move an order through a team pipeline while notifying the customer.
zh: 判断产品咨询资格并交给销售。
让订单按团队管线推进，并向客户发送通知。
use_cases.basis: Editorial examples, not measured customer conversions or implemented orders.

Channel model.en: Managed web/mobile application connected to a company WhatsApp setup; Meta and integration-account dependencies remain.
Channel model.zh: 托管网页／移动应用连接公司 WhatsApp 配置，仍依赖 Meta 及集成账户条件。

steps.en: Identify one incoming channel, the company WhatsApp connection and the intended owner/routing rule.
steps.zh: 确定一个输入渠道、公司 WhatsApp 连接及预期负责人／分配规则。

steps.en: For Facebook Lead Ads, arrange the required Business Manager admin access and map sample form variables.
steps.zh: 连接 Facebook Lead Ads 时，准备所需 Business Manager 管理权限并映射表单样例变量。

steps.en: Test bot qualification, a human handoff and the destination record before enabling a wider campaign.
steps.zh: 扩大活动前测试机器人判断、人工接手及目标记录。

items.name: Facebook Lead Ads
items.scope: Admin access and field/template setup required; no live ad or lead submitted.

items.en: Rule-based bots, AI bots, structured Flows and campaign retries have different plan/configuration conditions.
items.zh: 规则机器人、AI 机器人、结构化 Flows 及活动重试有不同套餐／配置条件。

items.en: The pricing page contains multiple conflicting generations of plans and older Meta billing explanations; no universal final quote is inferred.
items.zh: 定价页同时出现多代冲突套餐和旧 Meta 计费解释，不能推断统一最终报价。

pricing.billing_basis: Current top cards show annually billed monthly platform amounts and user allowances; Meta/provider and platform-credit charges are distinct. Conflicting legacy tables require quote confirmation.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Top cards show Starter ₹899, Standard ₹1,299 and Pro ₹2,399 per month billed annually, tax extra; 3/6/10 users respectively. Other embedded tables disagree.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 顶部卡片列出 Starter 每月899卢比、Standard 1,299、Pro 2,399，按年付款、税另计，分别3／6／10用户；嵌入的其他表格不同。

faq.question_en: Is a chatbot lead automatically a completed sale?
faq.question_zh: 机器人判断后的线索是否自动成为成交？
faq.answer_en: No. Qualification captures fields and routes work. The assigned team still needs to check the requirement and resulting record.
faq.answer_zh: 不是。资格判断用于采集字段和分配工作，接手团队仍需检查需求及目标记录。

faq.question_en: Can the old Free table prove zero ongoing cost?
faq.question_zh: 旧 Free 表格能否证明长期总成本为零？
faq.answer_en: No. The page mixes old tables, setup references, platform charges and Meta costs. A verified current offer is needed.
faq.answer_zh: 不能。页面混有旧表、实施费用、平台费用和 Meta 成本，需要核实当前方案。

official_check.scope: Public vendor documentation reviewed; no account execution, purchase, owner identity, independent review or publication approval.

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent reliability, usability or customer-outcome verification.
English and Chinese are paired drafts. Chinese text does not establish Chinese UI support.
All alternative relationships remain unreviewed. Public-web retrieval may use cached content; prices are dated observations.

sections.title_en: Worked example: inquiry, owner and next step
sections.title_zh: 示例：咨询、负责人及下一动作
sections.en:
Imagine a buyer asks about a product on the company's WhatsApp number. In a hypothetical Bytepaper workflow, a bot collects the requirement and location, a routing rule assigns an agent, and the agent continues with the conversation and lead context in view. The inbox documentation describes assignment, tags and pipeline-related work; this sequence was not executed.

Check the resulting contact and conversation owner, including an unassigned message and a change of agent. A reply sent or a pipeline stage updated does not establish that the customer accepted an order. Define the next accountable action rather than measuring the process only by message count.
sections.zh:
假设买家通过公司 WhatsApp 号码咨询产品。Bytepaper 的假设流程可由机器人采集需求及位置，再按规则分配坐席，由其带着沟通和线索背景继续处理。收件箱文档说明分配、标签及管线相关工作，但本文未执行该序列。

应核对最终联系人及沟通负责人，并包含未分配消息和更换坐席的情况。回复发出或阶段更新，不证明客户已接受订单。应定义有负责人负责的下一动作，而不只按消息数衡量流程。

sections.title_en: Lead Ads needs account access and real field mapping
sections.title_zh: Lead Ads 需要账户权限及真实字段映射
sections.en:
The Facebook integration page describes using form variables in WhatsApp templates, lead distribution rules and app notifications. It explicitly requires Facebook Business Manager admin access. Choose the real form, expected fields and receiving team instead of assuming that every ad account is connected by default.

For an evaluation, use a disposable submitted lead with an optional field missing and inspect what the template actually sends. Check that the lead source and assigned owner survive the handoff. Duplicate submissions, revoked account access, delivery failures and later edits need further verification; the feature page does not establish exactly-once delivery or a recovery contract.
sections.zh:
Facebook 集成页描述把表单变量用于 WhatsApp 模板、线索分配规则及应用提醒，并明确需要 Facebook Business Manager 管理权限。应选择真实表单、预期字段和接收团队，不能假定所有广告账户默认已连接。

评估时可使用缺少可选字段的可丢弃提交线索，检查模板实际发出什么，并核对来源和负责人是否保留。重复提交、账户权限被撤回、交付失败及后续编辑仍需验证；功能页没有确立恰好一次交付或恢复契约。

sections.title_en: Separate fixed steps from AI-generated answers
sections.title_zh: 区分固定步骤与 AI 生成回答
sections.en:
The chatbot page describes collecting customer details, asking qualification questions, assigning leads and sending order-related updates. Structured WhatsApp Flows collect selections and form inputs. It also advertises model-based bots, which are a different source of answers from predefined steps.

Decide which fields are authoritative and when a person takes over. Test an unknown requirement and a reply that does not fit the offered choices. A generated product recommendation must not be treated as verified inventory or an approved commercial promise without checking the source system. No bot accuracy, live model integration, escalation or order fulfillment was tested here.
sections.zh:
机器人页描述采集客户资料、提出资格问题、分配线索及发送订单相关更新。结构化 WhatsApp Flows 用于收集选择和表单输入，页面还宣传基于模型的机器人，其回答来源与预定义步骤不同。

应明确哪些字段有权威性，以及何时由人接手，并测试未知需求和不符合选项的回复。未经来源系统核对，生成的产品建议不能视为已验证库存或获准商业承诺。本文未测试机器人准确性、模型连接、升级处理或订单履约。

sections.title_en: Read the current cards without merging legacy tables
sections.title_zh: 读取当前卡片时不拼接旧表
sections.en:
The top pricing cards show Starter ₹899/month, Standard ₹1,299/month and Pro ₹2,399/month, billed annually before listed tax. Their included user counts are three, six and ten. Additional users are shown at ₹249/month, also billed annually. Basic chatbot steps sit in Starter; richer routing/drip functions and Flows/webhooks are presented on higher cards. Confirm exact entitlements in the selected offer.

The same page contains older Free/Growth/Scale and yearly tables that do not match those cards, including setup-charge references. It also mixes legacy and newer WhatsApp billing explanations. A 10-day trial advertised on product pages is not evidence of sustained zero-cost use. This profile records the observed cards but leaves a normalized payable price and free-plan eligibility unresolved.
sections.zh:
定价顶部卡片显示 Starter 每月899卢比、Standard 1,299、Pro 2,399，按年付款，所列税费另计，分别含3、6和10用户。额外用户列为每月249卢比，也按年付款。Starter 列有基础机器人步骤，更丰富路由／滴灌及 Flows／webhook 在更高卡片呈现，准确权益需按所选方案确认。

同页还有与之不一致的旧 Free／Growth／Scale 及年度表，并包含实施费用引用，也混有旧版和较新版 WhatsApp 计费解释。产品页宣传10天试用，不代表持续零成本使用。本文记录观察到的卡片，但保留实付标准价和免费套餐资格未定。

sections.title_en: Platform credits and provider charges are different
sections.title_zh: 平台积分与服务商费用不同
sections.en:
The pricing page says Bytepaper can add a platform per-message charge after its fair-use allowance of 50,000 Platform Credits. It distinguishes Partner-connected WhatsApp numbers from BSP-connected numbers for credit applicability. Meta charges and external services remain outside that platform calculation. Do not count a customer record, one conversation and one credit as interchangeable units.

Ask for the number-connection method, allowance reset, chargeable event and selected plan in writing. Exact Meta rates and messaging-window claims on the vendor page were not verified against Meta, so this profile does not repeat them as current provider policy. No message was sent and no platform-credit or Meta bill was measured.
sections.zh:
定价页说明，在50,000 Platform Credits 合理使用额度耗尽后，Bytepaper 可能另收平台每消息费用，并区分 Partner 方式连接与 BSP 方式连接的 WhatsApp 号码是否适用积分。Meta 及外部服务费用不在这个平台计算中，不能把一条客户记录、一次对话和一个积分当作相同单位。

应取得号码连接方式、额度重置、计费事件及所选套餐的书面说明。厂商页上的准确 Meta 费率和消息窗口说法未向 Meta 核实，因此本文不把它们重复为当前服务商政策。未发送消息，也未测量平台积分或 Meta 账单。

sections.title_en: Confirm the working contract and exception handling
sections.title_zh: 确认适用合同及异常处理
sections.en:
The public terms grant use of software as a service and discuss account charges, payment, termination and requesting data backups. Parts of the page retain unrelated payroll/service language. Confirm the actual signed product terms and export/retention arrangements before relying on that generic text; no self-hosting or open-source right was established.

Bytepaper merits evaluation for a team whose customer work genuinely flows through WhatsApp and needs shared ownership, qualification and follow-up. It needs further proof for exact permissions, full export, retry/duplicate behavior, regional availability, UI languages, hosting location and recovery. Generic encryption copy on the inbox page and promotional conversion/speed figures are not adopted as verified product security or customer outcomes.
sections.zh:
公开条款授予软件服务使用权，并讨论账户费用、付款、终止及数据备份请求，但部分文字保留了无关薪资／服务措辞。依赖通用文字前，应确认实际签署产品条款及导出／保留安排；本文未确立自行托管或开源权利。

客户工作确实围绕 WhatsApp 展开，需要共享负责人、资格判断及跟进的团队，可评估 Bytepaper。准确权限、完整导出、重试／重复行为、地区可用性、界面语言、托管位置和恢复则需更多证据。收件箱页通用加密文案及宣传的转化／速度数字，不作为已验证安全或客户成效采用。
